name: Cameo
source: The mysterious person who scouts Kiichi for the Chikan Fetishist Circle "Vatican". He has never appeared before Kiichi in the flesh and engages with Kiichi exclusively through a smartphone chat app. He's always in position to video Kiichi's molestation acts for later upload, but Kiichi has no idea of his exact position.
